name: Ironclad
summary: Contract lifecycle management for legal teams. Its agentic product is Contract Review Agent, renamed from Jurist by 2026-10-14, which the vendor says redlines a whole contract against the organization's playbook, on third-party paper, as a first pass before a lawyer reads it; Ironclad AI separately extracts properties, clauses and obligations from uploaded contracts. For agents it publishes a first-party MCP server, one URL per region: a read-only conversational search over contracts and create/read/update tools for obligations, connected by user OAuth, which answered 401 to a keyless probe.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-13, 09-14, 09-15 and 09-27, no credentials: MCP initialize answers 401 with a Bearer challenge at NA1 and EU1. Vendor: per-user OAuth. The authorization server named by the challenge publishes no registration_endpoint and advertises client_id_metadata_document_supported.

payments.notes: Read 2026-09-27: no listed surface prices a request or speaks a 402. Enterprise Services Agreement (July 1, 2026) s.3: invoiced annually in advance, non-cancellable, non-refundable; overage may be invoiced at then-current rates; AI Credit excess at an unpublished list price. Pricing: quote only.

jobs.summary: Redlining with Playbooks, re-read 2026-10-14: "Ironclad's AI Contract Review Agent can now redline directly against your organization's playbook, delivering a complete, sourced, reviewable first pass in under five minutes". Renamed from Jurist. Not measured: licensed, account-bound.
